claims.citation: New York Herald, 12 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Bark Princeton (of Shields), Sharp, Bordeaux, 53 days,
with mdse, to Anthony Oechs. May 19[?], lat 44 11, lon 37 30[?],
spoke brig Mary E Rowland, hence for London, 10 days out.
